purpose: Reference policy implemented by evaluation/run.py, backend.py and vllm_backend.py for release 1.0.0. This file documents the implementation; it is not a runtime override interface. CLI seed and input-limit overrides are recorded in each run manifest.

common.output_constraint: Greedy selection among canonical single-letter tokens at step one; force a model-specific EOS token at step two.
common.choice_token_ids: Resolve and validate using each pinned tokenizer; do not reuse IDs across models.
common.eos_token_ids: Read the checkpoint generation_config, falling back to the tokenizer.
common.evidence_block: Empty for no evidence; otherwise two newlines followed by evidence text. Preserve passage order and use two newlines between passages.
common.messages: One independent user turn per request; no scoring labels or construction/review metadata.
common.chat_template: Use each pinned checkpoint official template with add_generation_prompt=True and the kwargs from models.json.

transformers.loader: Use models.json loader; Gemma uses Gemma3ForConditionalGeneration with text inputs only.
transformers.constraints: Implement the two-step token mask, e.g. prefix_allowed_tokens_fn; prompt text and max_new_tokens alone do not enforce this policy.

vllm.constraints: Implement the V0 two-step logits processor for choice then EOS.
vllm.execution: One request per offline engine call.
